WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg,
        AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, a.district_id
),
region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(aa.amount_avg) AS amount_avg,
        AVG(aa.balance_avg) AS balance_avg
    FROM account_averages AS aa
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = aa.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    region,
    amount_avg,
    balance_avg,
    amount_avg / (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) FROM region_averages) AS amount_avg_ratio
FROM region_averages
WHERE (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) FROM region_averages) IS NOT NULL;
